plan.rule: The probe plan is deterministic and contains only local read-only operations. Its policy and discovery digests are part of the exact Bootstrap plan.

results.rule: A result is accepted only when its exact plan, policy, discovery, and canonical project-root binding match the expected values.

determinism: Canonical JSON recursively orders object keys by unsigned UTF-8 byte order; probe output retains typed observations and hashes raw command output without retaining unbounded or secret-bearing output.
containment: The project root must be a real directory, not a symlink. Probe execution never follows a project-root symlink.
